question: 지역별 매출 상위 5개 지역을 알려줘
sql: SELECT c.region AS region, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

question: 월별 주문 수를 알려줘
sql: SELECT to_char(o.ordered_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o GROUP BY to_char(o.ordered_at, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY order_month

question: 카테고리별 매출 합계를 알려줘
sql: SELECT cat.name AS category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.id GROUP BY cat.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: 가장 많이 팔린 상품 10개를 알려줘
sql: SELECT p.name AS product, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, product ASC LIMIT 10

question: 주문 상태별 주문 건수를 알려줘
sql: SELECT o.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY order_count DESC

question: 누적 구매액 상위 10명 고객을 알려줘
sql: SELECT c.name AS customer, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC, customer ASC LIMIT 10

question: 수도권 고객 수를 지역별로 알려줘
sql: SELECT c.region AS region, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers c WHERE c.region IN ('서울', '경기', '인천') GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY customer_count DESC

question: 취소된 주문 건수를 알려줘
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_order_count FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
